objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled document subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving within the P&R Management system

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the document (e.g., editing, review, released, out of force)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document indicating revision history

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Category of document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or title of the document

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Strategic regulations and processes documented in the policy

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting company-wide or locally defined regulations and instructions

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope of application for the guideline

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons

attributes.name: process_sequence
attributes.description: Step-by-step procedure defined in the instruction

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing detailed work steps and special procedures for specific departments

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document subject to versioning

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to release cycle of main document and without own release cycle

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for amending an existing document without affecting current version

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to extend the validity period of a document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person with defined roles and authorizations in the system

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator)

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with shared authorization and role assignments

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive)

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied during workflow steps

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which signature was applied

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users or user groups authorized to receive document notifications

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to a user within a document release or approval process

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of workflow task (creation, review, release, reactivation)

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a user that they have reviewed a document

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent version of a released document

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using the editing client

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Modification of document metadata and attributes

attributes.name: properties_changed
attributes.description: List of properties that were modified

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document to PDF format after saving

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the 3-step release process for a document

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Author or co-author who initiated the release

evts.name: author_sign
evts.description: First workflow step where registered author signs the document

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Workflow step where reviewers check document content

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final workflow step where releaser approves document for distribution

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after successful release

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of new document version due to content or property changes

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a change proposal for an existing document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Integration of a change proposal into a new document version

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request for validity extension 30 days before expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approval of document validity extension through workflow

attributes.name: extended_by
attributes.description: User who approved the validity extension

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to invalidate a document

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Final approval to invalidate and archive a document

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations for a document with archiving

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate an archived document

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Business Admin Group member creating the request

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Approval and re-validation of a previously invalidated document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and write permissions to users or user groups

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification to users when document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic email request for active confirmation of document acknowledgement

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by user of document acknowledgement

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of language-dependent version of released document

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Workflow review step for translated document

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval of translated document for publication

o2o.description: Document has associated controlled attachments that are released with the main document
Document has associated additional information not subject to release cycle
Change proposals belong to and reference a specific document
Validity extension request is linked to a document for validity check
Override request is created for a selected document
Reactivation request references a previously invalidated document
Translation is a language-dependent version of a released document
Attachments are archived with the document and have same validity as main document
Users are assigned to user groups with shared authorizations

o2e.description: Document is created as a new information object
Document content is edited through editing client
Document properties and metadata are maintained
Document is automatically converted to PDF
Release process is initiated for the document
Author signs and approves the document
Document is reviewed by assigned reviewers
Document is approved and released by releaser
Document is automatically published after release
New version of document is created due to changes
Change proposal is created for a document
Change proposal is implemented into new document version
System creates validity extension request for document
Validity of document is extended through workflow
Override request is created for document
Document is invalidated and declared out of force
Document authorizations are withdrawn and document is archived
Reactivation request is created for document
Document is re-validated and restored from archive
Authorization is assigned to user for document access
Authorization is assigned to user group for document access
Document is distributed to users via email notification
Acknowledgement is requested from users for document
User confirms acknowledgement of document
Document is translated to another language
Translation is reviewed by assigned reviewer
Translation is approved and released
